verdict.rationale: The pack shows Polar has payouts (withdrawals once a balance threshold is met) and a balance viewable on the dashboard Finance page. Nothing documents an API for listing payouts or balance transactions, or any way to tie a bank deposit back to its underlying charges. The MCP server's documented scope covers products, customers, subscriptions, orders and benefits, not payouts or balance transactions. Orders data alone does not amount to payout reconciliation.
